summary: All pages are visually intact with perfect accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores. The two project detail pages remain below the 85 performance threshold (/projects/note-structurer 77, LCP 4.3 s; /projects/screenshot-to-primevue 77, LCP 4.5 s), continuing a multi-audit streak with no meaningful improvement. The home page dipped to 85 (−4 pts) with TBT rising to 162 ms, just at the threshold but within jitter range; /projects also slipped to 84 (−4 pts), borderline.

top_fix: Optimize LCP on both project detail pages: convert all sample thumbnail and demo images to WebP at display size (~300 px wide), add loading="lazy" to below-fold thumbnails, and preload or inline the drop-zone and result-placeholder SVG icons. Both pages have now been below 85 for multiple consecutive audits (note-structurer: 3+ audits at 77–79; screenshot-to-primevue: seven consecutive audits) with LCP persistently above 4.3 s — image optimization is the highest-impact fix.
